links.outcome: LLM vs maxillofacial surgery residents on QAMAI quality scores across 30 cases
links.effect: Human surgery residents consistently scored higher than the LLMs across all QAMAI parameters (accuracy, clarity, relevance, completeness, references, usefulness); ChatGPT-4 outperformed Bard on additional examinations and treatment plans.
links.quote: Compared to LLMs, human surgery residents consistently scored higher across all parameters of the QAMAI tool, indicating superior accuracy, clarity, relevance, completeness, quality of references, and overall usefulness.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic and treatment recommendation accuracy of ChatGPT-4 and Google Bard compared to surgery residents on 30 real-world maxillofacial traumatology cases using standard assessment tools.
